rationale: The short entry was based on a sharp earnings‑driven gap down, high volume and price below the EMA/VWAP, all still intact. Although price has risen modestly toward the EMA, the stop is still ~5 ATR away and the take‑profit remains ~6 ATR below, offering a roughly 1:1 risk‑reward. With the negative earnings news still fresh, holding the short gives the trade time to work before the session ends.
